configure terminal

Enter configuration commands, one per line. End with CNTL/Z.

host01(config)# vlan 3900


host01(config-vlan)# exit


host01(config)# interface vlan 3900


host01(config-if)# ip address 192.0.2.1/28


host01(config-if)# ipv6 address 2001:db8:3900::1/64


host01(config-if)# no shutdown


host01(config-if)# exit


host01(config)# interface loopback 900


host01(config-if)# ip address 192.0.2.222/32


host01(config-if)# ipv6 address 2001:db8:900::1/128


host01(config-if)# exit


host01(config)# end


host01#
